test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Match the following:

 
 

 **Treaty**
 **Year**
 
 

 1. Treaty of Surat
 a. 1665
 
 

 2. Treaty of Salbai
 b. 1775
 
 

 3. Treaty of Purandhar
 c. 1782
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - b, 2 - c, 3 - a**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Treaty of Surat:__

 __
 
• It was signed between Raghunath Rao and the British East India Company (EIC).
 
• British EIC agreed to support the claim of Raghunathrao over Peshwaship.
 
• In return, Raghunathrao conceded Salsette and Bassein to the English.
 
• The Treaty of Surat in 1775 is considered the beginning of the First Anglo-Maratha War.
 
 
 
• **Treaty of Salbai:**__
 __
 
• With the **Treaty of Salbai,** the First Anglo-Maratha War ended.
 
• It was signed on** 17 May 1782 **between the **British East India Company and the Marathas.**
 
• Mahadaji Sindhia made an agreement with the English in October 1781 by which he agreed to negotiate with Poona Council for a treaty with the English.
 
• The negotiations started in early 1782 and the treaty of Salbai was signed between the English and the Marathas on May 17, 1782.
 
 
 
• **Treaty of Purandar:**__ 
 
 
• The treaty of Purandar was signed between the** Rajput ruler Jai Singh I,** who was commander of the **Mughal Empire**, and** Maratha Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.**
 
• This treaty was signed on** 11th June 1665. **
